title: One-shot momentum
claim: In 2024-25, within a player's game, a field-goal attempt is more likely to be made after a made field goal than after a missed one, beyond what within-player-game shuffling produces.
estimand: pooled P(make | previous FGA in same player-game made) - P(make | previous FGA missed)
sample: every 2024-25 field-goal attempt in sealed, non-quarantined games (D19; free throws out of scope, D12) with a known shooter and resolved event order (shots in a period with a clock regression excluded, D3)
test: permutation: outcomes shuffled within (player, game, shot value 2/3) strata, statistic recomputed, B=999, seed 20261109; one-sided p = (1 + #{T* >= T}) / (B + 1) (kernels.mc_pvalue)
null: outcomes are exchangeable within (player, game, shot value): no dependence on the previous shot
decision_rule: SURVIVED_PROTOCOL iff Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (no equivalence test registered); INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if the statistic is undefined, eligible FGA < 100000 or either conditioning set < 1000
interpretation_limit: association under within-player-game exchangeability; not causal. Harness family C (form drift, no streak) triggers the k=3 version 38% of the time.
